features.label: Whisper quiet motor technology
features.text: Engineered with an advanced internal motor that operates at an exceptionally low decibel level, ensuring your home recovery environment remains peaceful and conducive to uninterrupted sleep

features.label: Streamlined single flow setting
features.text: Removes the complexity of fluctuating temperatures by utilizing a precision-calibrated continuous flow rate that delivers optimal, doctor-recommended cooling directly to your inflamed tissues

features.label: Ultra compact portability
features.text: Thoughtfully designed with a minimal footprint that takes up very little space on your bedside table, while the lightweight construction makes it incredibly easy to transport between rooms or clinical appointments

features.label: Rapid therapy activation
features.text: Features highly intuitive fill instructions and a user-friendly interface so you can prepare the machine and begin your critical ice therapy sessions in mere minutes without unnecessary frustration

features.label: Perfect fit guarantee
features.text: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our US-based brace specialists for personalized support

measurement: The Cold Rush Compact includes a Universal Pad suitable for multiple body areas. Additional specialized pads are available (Knee, Ankle, and Lumbar pads offer a universal fit. For Hip pads, select Left or Right. For Shoulder pads, choose Small for 5 ft. 6 in. or shorter / chest under 42 in., or Large for 5 ft. 7 in. and taller / chest 42 in. and larger). Always use a protective skin barrier during use. Visit our Perfect Fit Promise page for more details.
